note: THE PROOF-OF-PROGRESS LEDGER for the BN1 route.
Each entry is the BEST result we have actually observed on that profile, not
a target and not a guess. Some of these numbers are FAILURES; they are here
because a failure you have measured is the starting point of the next
improvement, and because 'does not reach' is itself the fact to beat.
RULES.
1. Only ever move a number in the improving direction, and only from a run
you actually observed. Never relax one to make a red run green -- that
converts the ledger from evidence into decoration.
2. `timeToGoalHours` and `firstInstallHours` improve DOWNWARD.
`augmentationsAt`, `installs` and `reached` improve UPWARD.
3. `provenance` pins the simulator semantics these numbers were measured
under. Bumping SIMULATOR_MODEL_VERSION or the vendored commit changes
what the simulator DOES, so old numbers stop being comparable.
Re-measure every profile, then update provenance in the same commit.
HOW TO RE-MEASURE. These are minutes-to-hours of wall clock, so they are run
by hand rather than in a lane:
bun run tools/bn1-screen.ts --hours 4        # screen one configuration
bun run sim --profile bn1-full --compact     # the benchmark, seeds 1-3
bun run sim --profile bn1-speedrun --compact # the cheap regression guard
Screen on seed 1; confirm anything promising on all three before recording.

provenance.recordedFrom: re-measured after the BN1 route/arbiter pass: honest route ETAs (closed-form climbs, acquisition-aware invite/regrow, bank-netted donations), investment horizon fixes, wake coalescing, share cooldown, prestige killAll rounds, sim GC pacing

target.note: An optimal BN1 completes in under eight hours. bn1-full runs a 24h horizon; not reaching inside it is a defect to diagnose, not a score to optimise.

bn1-full.what: Cold BN1 start, 8 GB home, the full vanilla network, every playable feature. The headline route benchmark.
bn1-full.note: NOT REACHED, and the honest starting point. Before the cold-start install fixes this profile installed NOTHING in 24 hours and reported a 1,138-hour route estimate; it now installs on cadence and estimates ~40h. Reaching at all is the next milestone, then eight hours.
history: Before 2026-08-20: zero installs, zero augmentations, route ETA 1,137.7h at four hours. Three chained defects -- an early count tranche demanding a quarter of the whole gate, an unanchored power-law extrapolation, and faction work never announcing the augmentations it produces. See spec/progress.md, BN1 route ledger seventh pass.

bn1-speedrun.what: The cheap regression guard: $1b on the small deterministic early-game fixture.
bn1-speedrun.note: All three seeds now reach. The archived 2.43-2.46h generation predates the coding-contract runtime and the upstream batcher invariants; under model-10 semantics the honest-ETA strategy layer beats the previously recorded 6.23h/5.01h/DNF on every seed. The remaining spread (1.66h-3.61h) is decision-timing sensitivity worth studying.
history: 2026-08-20: seed 1 7.44h without the cold-start install fixes, 6.23h with them.
2026-08-20 (model 5): seed 1 6.23h, seed 3 5.01h, seed 2 not reached. 2026-08-27 (model 10, after the route/arbiter pass): all three seeds reach — 3.61h / 1.66h / 2.54h.
